E0108

`HookDecision.Fail` needs String (text), not Int (a whole number)

What

`HookDecision.Fail` needs String (text), not Int (a whole number)

Why

The decision payload must match the hook's declared payload or error type

Fix

Put the value in text with interpolation: "{x}"

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0108: Tests/UI/Closures/parallel_adapters_reject_unsafe_boundaries_before_codegen_6.stderr.

Error [jet.BindingTypeMismatch]: Argument 2 to `.para_fold()` should be fn(fn(Int) -[]> Int Never!, Int) -> fn(Int) -[]> Int Never!, not fn(fn(Int) -> Int, Int) -[]> (fn(Int) -> Int) Never!
  --> Tests/UI/Closures/parallel_adapters_reject_unsafe_boundaries_before_codegen_6.jet:4:9
    |
  4 |         fn(callback: fn(Int) -> Int, n: Int) { callback },
    |         ^^
 Why: Built-in methods need arguments of the right type
 Fix: Use fn(fn(Int) -[]> Int Never!, Int) -> fn(Int) -[]> Int Never! here
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0108

Error [jet.BindingTypeMismatch]: Argument 3 to `.para_fold()` should be fn(fn(Int) -[]> Int Never!, fn(Int) -[]> Int Never!) -> fn(Int) -[]> Int Never!, not fn(fn(Int) -> Int, fn(Int) -> Int) -[]> (fn(Int) -> Int) Never!
  --> Tests/UI/Closures/parallel_adapters_reject_unsafe_boundaries_before_codegen_6.jet:5:9
    |
  5 |         fn(left: fn(Int) -> Int, right: fn(Int) -> Int) { left },
    |         ^^
 Why: Built-in methods need arguments of the right type
 Fix: Use fn(fn(Int) -[]> Int Never!, fn(Int) -[]> Int Never!) -> fn(Int) -[]> Int Never! here
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0108

Error [jet.ValueNotSendable]: `parallel result` can't cross a parallel worker boundary because `fn(Int) -[]> Int Never!` isn't sendable
  --> Tests/UI/Closures/parallel_adapters_reject_unsafe_boundaries_before_codegen_6.jet:2:18
    |
  2 |     ignored: [1].para_fold(
    |                  ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A function value carries executable state, not a worker data value; this concurrent boundary moves owned values between workers
 Fix: Copy plain owned data into the worker, or keep this operation sequential
